purpose: Represent the controllable player body from the Phase 2 greybox.
review_need: Judge whether the player reads as controllable and does not imply attack, dash, weapon, aim, or final character identity.
implementation_need: Assess whether visual bounds can align with the existing player collision body.
excluded_for_phase3b: animation frames; costume variants; facial expression set; final character identity

purpose: Represent solid standing surfaces from the Phase 2 greybox.
review_need: Judge whether the surface reads as solid and distinct from background, obstacle, and goal.
implementation_need: Assess crop/tile extraction and visual-to-collision alignment.
excluded_for_phase3b: full tileset; slope tiles; moving platform visuals; background decoration

purpose: Represent static blockers or route constraints from the Phase 2 greybox.
review_need: Judge whether the obstacle reads as a blocker without implying enemy, trap, damage, collectible, or item behavior.
implementation_need: Assess whether the visual bounds can align with existing blocker collision.
excluded_for_phase3b: enemy sprites; hazard VFX; damage states; breakable block variants

purpose: Represent the right-side destination from the Phase 2 greybox.
review_need: Judge whether the goal reads as a destination and is not confused with obstacle, item, or reward object.
implementation_need: Assess whether the visual marker can remain separate from the trigger area.
excluded_for_phase3b: level-complete animation; reward chest; portal effect; progression UI

purpose: Represent the existing time-pressure signal from the Phase 2 greybox.
review_need: Judge whether the timer visual communicates time pressure without becoming score, ranking, or polished HUD scope.
implementation_need: Treat as visual reference unless a UI-specific Work Package authorizes HUD integration.
excluded_for_phase3b: score UI; rank medals; animated countdown; full HUD system
